content.short: Adaverse is a Cardano Ecosystem Accelerator & Incubator
content.description: Adaverse is a Cardano Ecosystem Accelerator & Incubator. It's a collaborative initiative between EMURGO and Everest Ventures Group that supports blockchain founders with funds, mentorship and tech infrastructure to scale Web3 solutions across the globe. Adaverse has invested in and accelerated over 45 companies across a variety of sectors, including Web3, exchanges, NFTs, gamefi, DeFi, and proptech. Adaverse is a Cardano Ecosystem Accelerator & Incubator.
